document-generator.description: Create DOCX, PPTX, PDF, and XLSX documents, extract text from workspace documents, convert workspace documents to agent-ready Markdown, and manage Document Generator references/view state.

argument_schema.description: Document Generator command arguments. With no action, generates a document from spec.

spec.description: Document generation specification for generate_document or validate_spec.

workspace_relative_path.description: Input file under storage/uploaded/ or storage/generated/. Required for extract_text and convert_to_markdown; Markdown conversion accepts files up to 10 MiB.

output_filename.description: Plain Markdown output filename for convert_to_markdown, for example report.md.

title.description: Optional display title for a converted Markdown artifact.

metadata.description: Optional caller metadata stored under document.metadata.request_metadata for Markdown conversion.

return_markdown.description: When true, include bounded Markdown text in the response. The Markdown file is always written.

max_return_chars.description: Maximum Markdown characters returned inline when return_markdown is true.

max_chars.description: Maximum extracted text characters returned by extract_text.

entity_id.description: Document reference id for reference resolve/summarize actions.
